EX13-07.name: The BlazeDragon Shining-Dragon-Flame
EX13-07.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing 4000 BP or less Spirit. When this effect destroys any Spirit, draw a card.

[LV3] [Charge]
Increase the limit of your "BP Destruction effects" by +1000.

EX13-09.name: The WaterDragon Shining-Dragon-Water
EX13-09.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] [Crush] (When Attacks)
Discard a number of cards equal to this Spirit's LV from the opposing decktop.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
When this Spirit's [Crush] discards any card with Burst effects, discard an opposing Burst.

[LV3] [Charge]
Your "opposing-deck-discarding effects" discard +1 card.

EX13-08.name: The WindDragon Shining-Dragon-Hurricane
EX13-08.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Exhaust an opposing Spirit. When this effect exhausts any Spirit, you can summon a Cost 3 or less Spirit card from your Hand, without paying the cost.

[LV3] [Charge]
Increase the number of bodies to be exhausted by your “opponent-targeting exhaustion effects“ by +1.
